001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhostCreator;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GhostFrequencies;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhost;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
011
012public class ZigguratGhostCreator extends BaseSensorGhostCreator {
013
014        @Override
015        public List<SensorGhost> createGhost(SensorGhostManager manager) {
016                if (!Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation().isHyperspace()) return null;
017                List<SensorGhost> result = new ArrayList<SensorGhost>();
018                ZigguratGhost g = new ZigguratGhost(manager);
019                if (!g.isCreationFailed()) {
020                        result.add(g);
021                }
022                return result;
023        }
024
025        @Override
026        public float getFrequency(SensorGhostManager manager) {
027                return GhostFrequencies.getZigguratFrequency(manager);
028        }
029
030        @Override
031        public float getTimeoutDaysOnSuccessfulCreate(SensorGhostManager manager) {
032                return 50f + manager.getRandom().nextFloat() * 50f;
033        }
034        
035        @Override
036        public boolean canSpawnWhilePlayerInAbyss() {
037                return true;
038        }
039}
